title: Mode 7 Engine
subtitle: Browser-based racing renderer
description: A JavaScript kart-racing engine that runs in the browser. I built the perspective renderer, player controls, AI racers, items, collisions, menus, and race logic.

components.heading: Mode 7 Engine
paragraphs: A JavaScript kart-racing engine that runs in the browser. I built the perspective renderer, player controls, AI racers, items, collisions, menus, and race logic.
The playable demo uses Mario Kart characters and track artwork. The code recreates the game’s rendering and gameplay systems.

components.alt: Character selection in the browser game, with Mario preview and the eight-racer grid.
components.alt_2: Live Mario Circuit gameplay with the perspective road, AI racers, race timer and minimap.
